commands.name: #P
commands.description: Stores how many payments to amortise (1 to 1,200) and works out that schedule; the next one starts where it left off.

commands.name: #T(list:n)
commands.description: In an equation: how many times flow n of the named CFLO list occurs.
Percent: after + or −, takes that percentage of the number before it (1250 + 7 % adds 87.50); otherwise divides the number by 100.

commands.name: %CH
commands.description: The change from OLD to NEW as a percentage of OLD. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

commands.name: %CHG
commands.description: Percent change: the menu of OLD, NEW and %CH.

commands.name: %T
commands.description: PART as a percentage of TOTAL. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

commands.name: %TOTL
commands.description: Percent of total: the menu of TOTAL, PART and %T.
Opens a parenthesis, so the part inside is worked out first.
Closes a parenthesis opened with (.
Adds the next number to the one before it.
Changes the sign of the number being keyed in or of the result shown.

commands.name: +HR
commands.description: Moves the clock one hour forward.

commands.name: +MIN
commands.description: Moves the clock one minute forward.

commands.name: +SEC
commands.description: Moves the clock one second forward.

commands.name: , (DISP)
commands.description: Shows numbers with a decimal comma and periods between groups of digits: 1.234,50.

commands.name: -HR
commands.description: Moves the clock one hour back.

commands.name: -MIN
commands.description: Moves the clock one minute back.

commands.name: -SEC
commands.description: Moves the clock one second back.

commands.name: . (DISP)
commands.description: Shows numbers with a decimal point and commas between groups of digits: 1,234.50.

commands.name: 1/x
commands.description: The reciprocal of the number shown.

commands.name: 10^X
commands.description: 10 raised to the power of the number shown.
Switches between the 12-hour and the 24-hour clock.
Uses the 30/360 calendar (twelve 30-day months).

commands.name: 360D
commands.description: The days from DATE1 to DATE2 counted with 30-day months and a 360-day year.

commands.name: 365D
commands.description: The days from DATE1 to DATE2 on a 365-day calendar, ignoring leap days.
Finishes the calculation on the calculator line and shows the result. In RPN mode this key is ENTER: it copies X into Y to start the next number.

commands.name: A/A
commands.description: Uses the actual/actual calendar.

commands.name: A/PM (APPT)
commands.description: Switches the appointment's time from AM to PM or back (12-hour clock).

commands.name: A/PM (SET)
commands.description: Switches the clock between AM and PM.

commands.name: ABS(x)
commands.description: In an equation: x without its sign.

commands.name: AC.FT
commands.description: A volume in acre-feet: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to acre-feet.

commands.name: ACCRU
commands.description: Interest accrued since the last coupon date up to settlement, per 100 of face value.

commands.name: ACOS
commands.description: The arc cosine of the number shown, as an angle in the mode in use.

commands.name: ACOS(x)
commands.description: In an equation: the arc cosine of x, in the angle mode in use.

commands.name: ACOSH
commands.description: The inverse hyperbolic cosine of the number shown (1 or more).

commands.name: ACOSH(x)
commands.description: In an equation: the inverse hyperbolic cosine of x.

commands.name: ACRE
commands.description: An area in acres: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a area was stored in another unit of AREA, converts it to acres.

commands.name: ACRS
commands.description: The ACRS deduction: BASIS times ACRS%.

commands.name: ACRS%
commands.description: The ACRS percentage from the published tables.

commands.name: ADJST
commands.description: Opens the menu that moves the clock forward or back by an hour, a minute or a second.

commands.name: ALG
commands.description: Algebraic entry: 2 + 3 = gives 5. The calculator starts in this mode.

commands.name: ALL
commands.description: Shows numbers with as many digits as they need, up to 12.

commands.name: ALOG(x)
commands.description: In an equation: 10 to the power x.

commands.name: AMRT
commands.description: Opens the amortisation menu, which splits payments into interest and principal and shows the balance.

commands.name: AND
commands.description: In an equation's condition: true when both sides are true.

commands.name: ANGLE(x:y)
commands.description: In an equation: the polar angle of the point (x, y), in the angle mode in use.

commands.name: ANN
commands.description: Coupons are paid once a year.

commands.name: APPT
commands.description: Opens the six appointments, with which are pending and which are past due.

commands.name: APPT1
commands.description: Opens an appointment (APPT1 to APPT6) to set or see its date, time, message and repeat.

commands.name: AREA
commands.description: Opens the area units.

commands.name: ASIN
commands.description: The arc sine of the number shown, as an angle in the mode in use.

commands.name: ASIN(x)
commands.description: In an equation: the arc sine of x, in the angle mode in use.

commands.name: ASINH
commands.description: The inverse hyperbolic sine of the number shown.

commands.name: ASINH(x)
commands.description: In an equation: the inverse hyperbolic sine of x.

commands.name: ATAN
commands.description: The arc tangent of the number shown, as an angle in the mode in use.

commands.name: ATAN(x)
commands.description: In an equation: the arc tangent of x, in the angle mode in use.

commands.name: ATANH
commands.description: The inverse hyperbolic tangent of the number shown (between −1 and 1).

commands.name: ATANH(x)
commands.description: In an equation: the inverse hyperbolic tangent of x.

commands.name: B
commands.description: In the FRCST menu: the B coefficient of the model; the y-intercept for the linear one.

commands.name: BAL
commands.description: What is left of the loan after the amortised payments.

commands.name: BASIS
commands.description: What the asset cost when it was bought: its depreciable basis.

commands.name: BBL
commands.description: A volume in barrels of oil (42 US gallons): stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to barrels of oil (42 US gallons).

commands.name: BD.FT
commands.description: A volume in board feet: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to board feet.

commands.name: BEEP
commands.description: Steps through the beeper settings: on, on for appointments only, off.

commands.name: BEG
commands.description: Begin mode: payments come at the start of each period, as with leases and savings plans.

commands.name: BOND
commands.description: Bond price and yield on any date: coupons once or twice a year, on a 30/360 or an actual/actual calendar.

commands.name: BU
commands.description: A volume in bushels: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to bushels.

commands.name: BUS
commands.description: Opens the business menus: percent change and total, markups, currency exchange, unit conversions.

commands.name: C.RCL
commands.description: Recalls a pair of currencies and its rate stored with C.STO.

commands.name: C.STO
commands.description: Stores the two currencies and the rate under one of the menu keys, to recall them later with C.RCL.

commands.name: CALC (CFLO)
commands.description: Opens the CFLO CALC menu: TOTAL, IRR%, I%, NPV, NUS, NFV for the current list.

commands.name: CALC (SOLVE)
commands.description: Checks the current equation and makes a menu of its variables, to store values and solve for any one of them.

commands.name: CALC (SUM)
commands.description: Opens the statistics of the current SUM list: total, mean, median, deviation, range, histogram, and FRCST for two lists.

commands.name: CALC (TIME)
commands.description: Opens date arithmetic: the day of the week, days between dates, a date some days away.

commands.name: CALL
commands.description: The call price per 100 of face value; 100 for a yield to maturity.

commands.name: CDATE
commands.description: In an equation: today's date, from the clock.

commands.name: CFLO
commands.description: Cash flows: lists of uneven cash flows for net present value, internal rate of return and more.

commands.name: CHAIN
commands.description: A length in chains: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a length was stored in another unit of LENG, converts it to chains.

commands.name: CLEAR
commands.description: Clears the calculator line to 0.

commands.name: CLEAR DATA
commands.description: Clears the history stack, and with it the variables of the menu on display or the list it shows (SUM, CFLO, TEXT, the Solver's equations).

commands.name: CM
commands.description: A length in centimetres: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a length was stored in another unit of LENG, converts it to centimetres.

commands.name: COMB(x:y)
commands.description: In an equation: how many ways there are to choose y items out of x, order not counted.

commands.name: CONT
commands.description: Continuous compounding: the menu of NOM% and EFF%.

commands.name: CONV
commands.description: Opens the conversions: degrees and radians, decimal hours and hours-minutes-seconds, and (MORE) polar and rectangular coordinates.

commands.name: COPY
commands.description: Copies the current list into a new list under the name you type.

commands.name: CORR
commands.description: In the FRCST menu: the correlation coefficient, from −1 to +1: how well the model fits the two lists.

commands.name: COS
commands.description: The cosine of the number shown, in the angle mode in use.

commands.name: COS(x)
commands.description: In an equation: the cosine of x, in the angle mode in use.

commands.name: COSH
commands.description: The hyperbolic cosine of the number shown.

commands.name: COSH(x)
commands.description: In an equation: the hyperbolic cosine of x.

commands.name: COST (MU%C)
commands.description: The cost of an item. Stores the number shown, or works it out from PRICE and M%C.

commands.name: COST (MU%P)
commands.description: The cost of an item. Stores the number shown, or works it out from PRICE and M%P.

commands.name: CPN%
commands.description: The yearly coupon rate in percent.

commands.name: CTIME
commands.description: In an equation: the time now, from the clock.

commands.name: CU.FT
commands.description: A volume in cubic feet: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to cubic feet.

commands.name: CU.IN
commands.description: A volume in cubic inches: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to cubic inches.

commands.name: CU.M
commands.description: A volume in cubic metres: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to cubic metres.

commands.name: CU.YD
commands.description: A volume in cubic yards: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to cubic yards.

commands.name: CUP
commands.description: A volume in cups: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to cups.

commands.name: CURR
commands.description: Replaces the label of the current item with the text typed.

commands.name: CURR1
commands.description: The first currency (US$ until another is chosen with SELCT): stores an amount in it, or converts the second currency's amount into it.

commands.name: CURR2
commands.description: The second currency (YEN until another is chosen with SELCT): stores an amount in it, or converts the first currency's amount into it.

commands.name: CURRX
commands.description: Currency exchange between two currencies at an exchange rate; the top line says how many units of the second one equal one of the first.

commands.name: CWT
commands.description: A mass in short hundredweights: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a mass was stored in another unit of MASS, converts it to short hundredweights.

commands.name: CX,Y
commands.description: The number of combinations: ways to choose Y items out of X, order not counted.

commands.name: D.GAL
commands.description: A volume in dry gallons: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to dry gallons.

commands.name: D/R
commands.description: Switches the angle mode between degrees and radians; the RAD annunciator shows radians.

commands.name: D/R (CONV)
commands.description: Switches the angle mode between degrees and radians.

commands.name: DATE (APPT)
commands.description: Sets the appointment's date to the date shown.

commands.name: DATE (SET)
commands.description: Sets the date to the number shown (MM.DDYYYY or DD.MMYYYY).

commands.name: DATE(d1:n)
commands.description: In an equation: the date n days after d1 (before it when n is negative), in the date format set in TIME SET.

commands.name: DATE1
commands.description: The first date: stores the date shown (with its day of the week) or works it out from DATE2 and DAYS.

commands.name: DATE2
commands.description: The second date: stores the date shown or works it out from DATE1 and DAYS.

commands.name: DAY
commands.description: Repeats the appointment every so many days (the number shown).

commands.name: DAYS
commands.description: The actual number of days from DATE1 to DATE2, leap years counted. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

commands.name: DB
commands.description: The declining-balance depreciation for year YR#, with the remaining depreciable value.

commands.name: DBL
commands.description: Switches double-spaced printing on and off.

commands.name: DDAYS(d1:d2:cal)
commands.description: In an equation: the days from d1 to d2 on calendar cal: 1 actual, 2 the 365-day year, 3 the 360-day year.

commands.name: DEG(x)
commands.description: In an equation: x radians in decimal degrees.

commands.name: DEL
commands.description: Removes the character under the cursor.

commands.name: DELET (CFLO)
commands.description: Deletes the flow shown.

commands.name: DELET (SOLVE)
commands.description: Deletes the current equation, or only its variables.

commands.name: DELET (SUM)
commands.description: Deletes the item shown.

commands.name: DELET (TEXT)
commands.description: Deletes the current entry.

commands.name: DEMO
commands.description: Runs the display demonstration; hold = to freeze it, press ON to end it.

commands.name: DEPRC
commands.description: Depreciation by declining balance, sum of the years' digits, straight line or ACRS.

commands.name: DISP
commands.description: Opens the DISP menu to set how numbers are shown: decimal places and the radix mark.

commands.name: DISPL
commands.description: Prints lines 1 to 3 of the display.

commands.name: DRAM
commands.description: A mass in drams: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a mass was stored in another unit of MASS, converts it to drams.

commands.name: E
commands.description: Starts the exponent of a number in scientific notation: 6 E 3 is 6,000.

commands.name: EDIT (SOLVE)
commands.description: Opens the current equation for editing with the letter keys and the cursor keys.

commands.name: EDIT (TEXT)
commands.description: Edits the current entry; also shows entries longer than 22 characters.

commands.name: EFF% (CONT)
commands.description: The effective yearly rate in percent of continuous compounding. Stores the number shown, or works it out from NOM%.

commands.name: EFF% (PER)
commands.description: The effective yearly rate in percent. Stores the number shown, or works it out from NOM% and P.

commands.name: END
commands.description: End mode: each payment comes at the close of its period, as with most loans.

commands.name: EXIT
commands.description: Goes back to the previous menu.

commands.name: EXP
commands.description: e raised to the power of the number shown.

commands.name: EXP (FRCST)
commands.description: After FRCST and the two lists: fits an exponential curve, y = B·e^(M·x).

commands.name: EXP(x)
commands.description: In an equation: e to the power x.

commands.name: EXPM1(x)
commands.description: In an equation: e to the power x, less 1, exact for small x.

commands.name: FACT%
commands.description: The declining-balance rate, in percent of the straight-line rate (200 for double declining balance).

commands.name: FACT(x)
commands.description: In an equation: the factorial of a whole number x.

commands.name: FATH
commands.description: A length in fathoms: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a length was stored in another unit of LENG, converts it to fathoms.

commands.name: FEET
commands.description: A length in feet: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a length was stored in another unit of LENG, converts it to feet.

commands.name: FIN
commands.description: Opens the finance menus: TVM, ICONV, CFLO, BOND, DEPRC.

commands.name: FIND
commands.description: Searches the list for the characters you type.

commands.name: FIX
commands.description: Sets how many decimal places numbers show: type 0 to 11, then INPUT.

commands.name: FL.OZ
commands.description: A volume in US fluid ounces: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to US fluid ounces.

commands.name: FLOW(list:n)
commands.description: In an equation: flow number n of the named CFLO list.

commands.name: FP(x)
commands.description: In an equation: the fractional part of x.

commands.name: FRCST
commands.description: Two-list statistics: choose the x list, the y list and a model, then the menu for forecasts, curve fitting, plots, weighted mean and summations.

commands.name: FV
commands.description: The future value: the amount at the close of the last period. Money paid out is negative.

commands.name: FV(n:i%yr:pv:pmt:p/yr:m)
commands.description: In an equation: the future value, from the other TVM values; m is 1 for Begin mode, 0 for End mode.

commands.name: G.SD
commands.description: In the FRCST menu: the standard deviation of the x values grouped by the frequencies in the y list.

commands.name: GAL
commands.description: A volume in US gallons: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to US gallons.

commands.name: GET (CFLO)
commands.description: Switches to another named cash-flow list, or starts a new one (*NEW).

commands.name: GET (SUM)
commands.description: Switches to another named SUM list, or starts a new one (*NEW).

commands.name: GET (TEXT)
commands.description: Switches to another named TEXT list, or starts a new one (*NEW).

commands.name: GLOBL
commands.description: Replaces the label of every item in the list with the text typed.

commands.name: GR
commands.description: A mass in grains: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a mass was stored in another unit of MASS, converts it to grains.

commands.name: GRAM
commands.description: A mass in grams: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a mass was stored in another unit of MASS, converts it to grams.

commands.name: HA
commands.description: An area in hectares: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a area was stored in another unit of AREA, converts it to hectares.

commands.name: HELP (APPT)
commands.description: Shows the formats for an appointment's date and time.

commands.name: HELP (SET)
commands.description: Shows how to key in the date and the time.

commands.name: HIST
commands.description: Draws a histogram of the list.

commands.name: HMS(t)
commands.description: In an equation: hours with a decimal fraction turned into HH.MMSS.

commands.name: HR
commands.description: Repeats the appointment every so many hours (the number shown).

commands.name: HRS(t)
commands.description: In an equation: a time in HH.MMSS turned into hours with a decimal fraction.

commands.name: HYP
commands.description: Opens the hyperbolic functions and their inverses.

commands.name: I% (CFLO)
commands.description: The interest rate per period used for NPV, NUS and NFV (cost of capital, discount rate).

commands.name: I%YR
commands.description: The nominal yearly interest rate, in percent. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

commands.name: I%YR(n:pv:pmt:fv:p/yr:m)
commands.description: In an equation: the yearly interest rate in percent, from the other TVM values; m is 1 for Begin mode, 0 for End mode.

commands.name: I.GAL
commands.description: A volume in Imperial gallons: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to Imperial gallons.

commands.name: ICONV
commands.description: Interest conversion: between nominal and effective yearly rates, for periodic or continuous compounding.

commands.name: IDIV(x:y)
commands.description: In an equation: the whole-number part of x divided by y.

commands.name: IF(cond:then:else)
commands.description: In an equation: the value of then when cond is true, else the value of else. Conditions use = < > ≤ ≥ ≠ and AND, OR, XOR, NOT.

commands.name: INCH
commands.description: A length in inches: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a length was stored in another unit of LENG, converts it to inches.

commands.name: INPUT
commands.description: Enters what the calculator line holds: an item into a list, an equation, text, or an answer to a prompt.

commands.name: INS
commands.description: Switches between inserting characters at the cursor and typing over them.

commands.name: INSRT (CFLO)
commands.description: Inserts a flow before the one shown.

commands.name: INSRT (SUM)
commands.description: Inserts an item before the one shown.

commands.name: INT
commands.description: The part of the amortised payments that went to interest.

commands.name: INT(x)
commands.description: In an equation: the largest whole number not above x.

commands.name: INTL
commands.description: Opens the choice of language for messages and labels.

commands.name: INV(x)
commands.description: In an equation: 1/x.

commands.name: IP(x)
commands.description: In an equation: the integer part of x, its fraction dropped.

commands.name: IRR%
commands.description: The internal rate of return per period: the discount rate that makes NPV of the flows zero.

commands.name: ITEM(list:n)
commands.description: In an equation: item number n of the named SUM list.

commands.name: KG
commands.description: A mass in kilograms: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a mass was stored in another unit of MASS, converts it to kilograms.

commands.name: KM
commands.description: A length in kilometres: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a length was stored in another unit of LENG, converts it to kilometres.

commands.name: L.CWT
commands.description: A mass in long hundredweights: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a mass was stored in another unit of MASS, converts it to long hundredweights.

commands.name: L.TON
commands.description: A mass in long tons: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a mass was stored in another unit of MASS, converts it to long tons.

commands.name: LABEL
commands.description: Gives the item shown a label of its own (CURR) or every item the same label (GLOBL).

commands.name: LAST
commands.description: Copies the number on line 2 (the last result) into the calculation in progress. In RPN mode it recalls the LAST X register.

commands.name: LB
commands.description: A mass in pounds: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a mass was stored in another unit of MASS, converts it to pounds.

commands.name: LENG
commands.description: Opens the length units.

commands.name: LIFE
commands.description: The useful life in whole years.

commands.name: LIN
commands.description: After FRCST and the two lists: fits a straight line, y = B + M·x.

commands.name: LIST
commands.description: Prints the values of the menu on display, or the list it shows, or the appointments in the APPT menu.

commands.name: LITER
commands.description: A volume in litres: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to litres.

commands.name: LN
commands.description: The natural (base e) logarithm of the number shown.

commands.name: LN(x)
commands.description: In an equation: the natural logarithm of x.

commands.name: LNP1(x)
commands.description: In an equation: the natural logarithm of 1 + x, exact for small x.

commands.name: LOG
commands.description: The common (base 10) logarithm of the number shown.

commands.name: LOG (FRCST)
commands.description: After FRCST and the two lists: fits a logarithmic curve, y = B + M·ln x.

commands.name: LOG(x)
commands.description: In an equation: the base-10 logarithm of x.

commands.name: LOGS
commands.description: Opens the logarithms, powers of 10 and e, and (HYP) the hyperbolic functions.

commands.name: M (FRCST)
commands.description: In the FRCST menu: the M coefficient of the model; the slope for the linear one.

commands.name: M (LENG)
commands.description: A length in metres: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a length was stored in another unit of LENG, converts it to metres.

commands.name: M%C
commands.description: The markup (PRICE less COST) as a percentage of COST. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

commands.name: M%P
commands.description: The markup (PRICE less COST) as a percentage of PRICE. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

commands.name: M/D
commands.description: Switches the date format from month/day/year to day.month.year and back.

commands.name: MAIN
commands.description: Goes straight back to the MAIN menu from any menu.

commands.name: MARK
commands.description: Adds a record marker below the current entry, so entries group into records.

commands.name: MASS
commands.description: Opens the mass and weight units.

commands.name: MAT
commands.description: The maturity date, or the call date (which must be a coupon date).

commands.name: MATH
commands.description: Opens the MATH menu: rounding, π, logarithms and hyperbolic functions, trigonometry, conversions and probability.

commands.name: MAX
commands.description: The biggest number of the list.

commands.name: MAX(x:y)
commands.description: In an equation: the larger of x and y.

commands.name: MEAN
commands.description: The average (arithmetic mean) of the list.

commands.name: MEDN
commands.description: The median of the list.

commands.name: MEM
commands.description: Shows how many bytes of memory are free while the key is held.

commands.name: MG
commands.description: A mass in milligrams: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a mass was stored in another unit of MASS, converts it to milligrams.

commands.name: MILE
commands.description: A length in miles: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a length was stored in another unit of LENG, converts it to miles.

commands.name: MIN (RPT)
commands.description: Repeats the appointment every so many minutes (the number shown).

commands.name: MIN (SUM)
commands.description: The smallest value of the list.

commands.name: MIN(x:y)
commands.description: In an equation: the smaller of x and y.

commands.name: ML
commands.description: A volume in millilitres: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to millilitres.

commands.name: MM
commands.description: A length in millimetres: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a length was stored in another unit of LENG, converts it to millimetres.

commands.name: MOD(x:y)
commands.description: In an equation: the remainder of x divided by y, x − y·INT(x/y).

commands.name: MODES
commands.description: Opens the MODES menu: the angle mode, the beeper, the printer's power, the language, the demo, and (MORE) ALG or RPN entry.

commands.name: MORE (BOND)
commands.description: The second BOND menu: YLD%, PRICE, ACCRU.

commands.name: MORE (CONV)
commands.description: The second CONV menu: polar and rectangular coordinates.

commands.name: MORE (DEPRC)
commands.description: The second DEPRC menu: YR#, FACT% and the three methods.

commands.name: MORE (SUM CALC)
commands.description: The second CALC menu: MIN, MAX, SORT, FRCST, HIST.

commands.name: MORE (SUM)
commands.description: The second SUM menu: COPY, LABEL, START, SUBT.

commands.name: MORE (TEXT)
commands.description: The second TEXT menu: FIND, EDIT, PREV, NEXT, SORT.

commands.name: MSG
commands.description: Types or shows the appointment's message.

commands.name: MU%C
commands.description: Markup on cost: the menu of COST, PRICE and M%C.

commands.name: MU%P
commands.description: Markup on price: the menu of COST, PRICE and M%P.

commands.name: N
commands.description: How many payments or compounding periods there are. Stores the number shown, or works it out from the others. ⇧ N stores the number shown times P/YR (years to payments).

commands.name: N!
commands.description: The factorial of the number shown, a whole number from 0 to 253.

commands.name: N(i%yr:pv:pmt:fv:p/yr:m)
commands.description: In an equation: the number of payments, from the other TVM values; m is 1 for Begin mode, 0 for End mode.

commands.name: N.MI
commands.description: A length in nautical miles: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a length was stored in another unit of LENG, converts it to nautical miles.

commands.name: NAME (CFLO)
commands.description: Names or renames the current cash-flow list.

commands.name: NAME (SUM)
commands.description: Names or renames the current SUM list.

commands.name: NAME (TEXT)
commands.description: Names or renames the current TEXT list.

commands.name: NEW
commands.description: The new value of a percent change. Stores the number shown, or works it out from OLD and %CH.

commands.name: NEXT (AMRT)
commands.description: Works out the next schedule of #P payments.

commands.name: NEXT (TEXT)
commands.description: Jumps to the entry under the next record marker.

commands.name: NFV
commands.description: The net future value: NPV carried forward to the last period at I%.

commands.name: NOM% (CONT)
commands.description: The nominal yearly rate in percent, compounded continuously. Stores the number shown, or works it out from EFF%.

commands.name: NOM% (PER)
commands.description: The nominal yearly rate in percent, compounded P times a year. Stores the number shown, or works it out from EFF%.

commands.name: NONE
commands.description: The appointment does not repeat.

commands.name: NOT
commands.description: In an equation's condition: true when what follows is false.

commands.name: NPV
commands.description: NPV of the cash flows at the rate I%: their net present value.

commands.name: NUS
commands.description: The net uniform series: the equal flow per period whose present value equals NPV.

commands.name: OLD
commands.description: The old value of a percent change. Stores the number shown, or works it out from NEW and %CH.

commands.name: ON
commands.description: Turns the calculator on; pressed while it is on, turns it off. Continuous memory keeps everything. Also ends the demo.

commands.name: OR
commands.description: In an equation's condition: true when either side is true.

commands.name: OTHER
commands.description: The second TVM menu: payments per year, begin or end mode, amortisation.

commands.name: OZ
commands.description: A mass in ounces: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a mass was stored in another unit of MASS, converts it to ounces.

commands.name: OZ.T
commands.description: A mass in troy ounces: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a mass was stored in another unit of MASS, converts it to troy ounces.

commands.name: P
commands.description: How many times a year interest is compounded.

commands.name: P/YR
commands.description: Sets how many payments there are per year, 1 to 999.

commands.name: PART
commands.description: The share of TOTAL. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

commands.name: PECK
commands.description: A volume in pecks: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to pecks.

commands.name: PER
commands.description: Periodic compounding: the menu of NOM%, EFF% and P.

commands.name: PERM(x:y)
commands.description: In an equation: how many ordered arrangements of y items there are out of x.

commands.name: PI
commands.description: Puts π (3.14159265359) into the calculator line.

commands.name: PINT
commands.description: A volume in US pints: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to US pints.

commands.name: PLOT (CFLO)
commands.description: Plots NPV against I% from −18% to 50%; the arrow keys move a cursor along the curve.

commands.name: PLOT (FRCST)
commands.description: In the FRCST menu: plots the x,y points and the fitted curve.

commands.name: PMT
commands.description: The amount of each equal payment. Money paid out is negative. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

commands.name: PMT(n:i%yr:pv:fv:p/yr:m)
commands.description: In an equation: the payment, from the other TVM values; m is 1 for Begin mode, 0 for End mode.

commands.name: PREV
commands.description: Jumps to the entry under the previous record marker.

commands.name: PRICE (BOND)
commands.description: The price per 100 of face value. Stores the number shown, or works it out from YLD%.

commands.name: PRICE (MU%C)
commands.description: The selling price. Stores the number shown, or works it out from COST and M%C.

commands.name: PRICE (MU%P)
commands.description: The selling price. Stores the number shown, or works it out from COST and M%P.

commands.name: PRIN
commands.description: The part of the amortised payments that went to principal.

commands.name: PRINTER
commands.description: Opens the PRINTER menu: print the display, the current menu's values or list, the registers or the time; double spacing; trace printing.

commands.name: PRNT
commands.description: Prints the calculator line on the infrared printer. With letters typed (no menu asking for them), prints them as a message.

commands.name: PRNTR
commands.description: Tells the calculator whether the printer runs on its AC adapter (it then prints faster) or on batteries.

commands.name: PROB
commands.description: Opens combinations, permutations, factorial and random numbers.

commands.name: PV
commands.description: The present value: the loan amount or the first investment, at the start of the first period. Money paid out is negative.

commands.name: PV(n:i%yr:pmt:fv:p/yr:m)
commands.description: In an equation: the present value, from the other TVM values; m is 1 for Begin mode, 0 for End mode.

commands.name: PWR
commands.description: After FRCST and the two lists: fits a power curve, y = B·x^M.

commands.name: PX,Y
commands.description: The number of permutations: ordered arrangements of Y items out of X.

commands.name: QUART
commands.description: A volume in US quarts: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to US quarts.

commands.name: R
commands.description: The radius (distance from the origin) of a point: stored, or worked out from XCORD and YCORD.

commands.name: RAD(x)
commands.description: In an equation: x decimal degrees in radians.

commands.name: RADIUS(x:y)
commands.description: In an equation: the distance of the point (x, y) from the origin.

commands.name: RAN#
commands.description: A random number from 0 up to 1. STO RAN# seeds it with the number shown (0 takes a seed from the clock).

commands.name: RANG
commands.description: The biggest number of the list less the smallest.

commands.name: RATE
commands.description: The exchange rate: how many units of the second currency make one of the first. Stores the number shown, or works it out from the two amounts.

commands.name: RCL
commands.description: Recalls a register (then a digit 0-9) or the value of a menu variable (then its menu key) into the calculator line, without calculating it.

commands.name: REGS
commands.description: Prints registers 0 to 9.

commands.name: RND
commands.description: Rounds the number shown to the decimal places on display; later calculations use the rounded value.

commands.name: RND(x:y)
commands.description: In an equation: x rounded to y places after the point (y from 0 to 11), or to −y significant digits (y from −12 to −1).

commands.name: ROD
commands.description: A length in rods: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a length was stored in another unit of LENG, converts it to rods.

commands.name: RPN
commands.description: RPN entry: 2 ENTER 3 + gives 5. The = key becomes ENTER and the stack's X register is the calculator line.

commands.name: RPT
commands.description: Shows how often the appointment repeats and opens the menu to change it.

commands.name: R↓
commands.description: In RPN mode, rolls the stack down: X goes to T and the others move down.

commands.name: S(var)
commands.description: In an equation: true when the Solver is solving for var. With IF it puts several related equations into one menu.

commands.name: SALV
commands.description: The salvage value left when the asset's life ends (0 if none).

commands.name: SELCT
commands.description: Chooses the two currencies from the menus of about forty (US$, CAN$, DM, FF, UK£ and more under MORE); a key for any other is there too.

commands.name: SEMI
commands.description: Coupons are paid twice a year.

commands.name: SET
commands.description: Opens the menu that sets the date and time and their formats.

commands.name: SETT
commands.description: The settlement (purchase) date, keyed in the date format in use.

commands.name: SGN(x)
commands.description: In an equation: 1 when x is positive, 0 when it is zero, −1 when it is negative.

commands.name: SHOW
commands.description: Shows the number with all its 12 digits while the key is held.

commands.name: SIN
commands.description: The sine of the number shown, in degrees or radians as the angle mode says.

commands.name: SIN(x)
commands.description: In an equation: the sine of x, in the angle mode in use.

commands.name: SINH
commands.description: The hyperbolic sine of the number shown.

commands.name: SINH(x)
commands.description: In an equation: the hyperbolic sine of x.

commands.name: SIZE
commands.description: In the FRCST menu: how many items each of the two lists holds.

commands.name: SIZEC(list)
commands.description: In an equation: the number of the final flow of the named CFLO list.

commands.name: SIZES(list)
commands.description: In an equation: how many items the named SUM list holds.

commands.name: SL
commands.description: Depreciation by the straight-line method for the year in YR#.

commands.name: SLUG
commands.description: A mass in slugs: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a mass was stored in another unit of MASS, converts it to slugs.

commands.name: SOLVE
commands.description: Opens the Solver: type your own equations and solve them for any variable.

commands.name: SORT (SUM)
commands.description: Sorts the list from the smallest number up; labels stay with their numbers.

commands.name: SORT (TEXT)
commands.description: Sorts the list alphabetically, after asking.

commands.name: SOYD
commands.description: Depreciation by the sum-of-the-years'-digits method for the year in YR#.

commands.name: SPACE
commands.description: Types a space; in letter typing, inserts one at the cursor.

commands.name: SPFV(i%:n)
commands.description: In an equation: what 1 paid now is worth after n periods at i% per period, (1 + i%/100)^n.

commands.name: SPPV(i%:n)
commands.description: In an equation: what 1 paid after n periods at i% per period is worth now, 1/SPFV(i%:n).

commands.name: SQ(x)
commands.description: In an equation: x squared.

commands.name: SQ.CM
commands.description: An area in square centimetres: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a area was stored in another unit of AREA, converts it to square centimetres.

commands.name: SQ.FT
commands.description: An area in square feet: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a area was stored in another unit of AREA, converts it to square feet.

commands.name: SQ.IN
commands.description: An area in square inches: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a area was stored in another unit of AREA, converts it to square inches.

commands.name: SQ.K
commands.description: An area in square kilometres: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a area was stored in another unit of AREA, converts it to square kilometres.

commands.name: SQ.M
commands.description: An area in square metres: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a area was stored in another unit of AREA, converts it to square metres.

commands.name: SQ.MI
commands.description: An area in square miles: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a area was stored in another unit of AREA, converts it to square miles.

commands.name: SQ.RD
commands.description: An area in square rods: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a area was stored in another unit of AREA, converts it to square rods.

commands.name: SQ.YD
commands.description: An area in square yards: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a area was stored in another unit of AREA, converts it to square yards.

commands.name: SQRT(x)
commands.description: In an equation: the square root of x.

commands.name: ST.MI
commands.description: A length in US statute miles: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a length was stored in another unit of LENG, converts it to US statute miles.

commands.name: START (SUM)
commands.description: Marks the item shown as the start of a subtotal.

commands.name: START (TABLE)
commands.description: Prints the amortisation table up to the payment number shown.

commands.name: STDEV
commands.description: The sample standard deviation of the list.

commands.name: STO
commands.description: Stores the number shown: then press a digit 0-9 for a register or a menu key for a variable. STO + − × ÷ before the register does the arithmetic in it.

commands.name: STONE
commands.description: A mass in stones: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a mass was stored in another unit of MASS, converts it to stones.

commands.name: SU.FT
commands.description: A length in survey feet: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a length was stored in another unit of LENG, converts it to survey feet.

commands.name: SUBT
commands.description: The subtotal from the START item to the item shown.

commands.name: SUM
commands.description: Opens SUM: lists of numbers with their running total, subtotals, labels and statistics.

commands.name: T
commands.description: A mass in metric tons: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a mass was stored in another unit of MASS, converts it to metric tons.

commands.name: TABLE
commands.description: Opens the printing of an amortisation table: type the number of the final payment to print, then press START.

commands.name: TAN
commands.description: The tangent of the number shown, in the angle mode in use.

commands.name: TAN(x)
commands.description: In an equation: the tangent of x, in the angle mode in use.

commands.name: TANH
commands.description: The hyperbolic tangent of the number shown.

commands.name: TANH(x)
commands.description: In an equation: the hyperbolic tangent of x.

commands.name: TBSP
commands.description: A volume in tablespoons: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to tablespoons.

commands.name: TEMP
commands.description: Opens the temperature units.

commands.name: TEXT
commands.description: Opens TEXT: lists of notes, names and addresses, with record markers, searching and sorting.

commands.name: TIME
commands.description: Shows the date and time and opens the TIME menu: date arithmetic, appointments, adjusting and setting the clock.

commands.name: TIME (APPT)
commands.description: Sets the appointment's time to the time shown (HH.MM); a past date becomes today.

commands.name: TIME (PRINTER)
commands.description: Prints the date and time.

commands.name: TIME (SET)
commands.description: Sets the time to the number shown (HH.MMSS).

commands.name: TODAY
commands.description: Puts today's date into the calculator line, to store in DATE1 or DATE2.

commands.name: TON
commands.description: A mass in short tons: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a mass was stored in another unit of MASS, converts it to short tons.

commands.name: TOTAL (%TOTL)
commands.description: The whole amount, of which PART is a share. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

commands.name: TOTAL (CFLO)
commands.description: All the cash flows of the list added up.

commands.name: TOTAL (SUM)
commands.description: All the numbers of the list added up.

commands.name: TRACE
commands.description: Turns trace printing on or off: with it on, every calculation is printed as it is done.

commands.name: TRIG
commands.description: Opens the trigonometric functions.

commands.name: TRN(x:y)
commands.description: In an equation: x cut off (not rounded) to y decimal places, or to −y significant digits when y is negative.

commands.name: TSP
commands.description: A volume in teaspoons: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to teaspoons.

commands.name: TVM
commands.description: Time value of money: works out loans, savings, leases and their amortisation from the five values N, I%YR, PV, PMT, FV.

commands.name: TYPE
commands.description: Opens the menu of bond types: calendar and coupon frequency.

commands.name: UNITS
commands.description: Unit conversions: length, area, volume, mass and temperature. In one of their menus, store a value in one unit, then press another unit to convert it.

commands.name: USFV(i%:n)
commands.description: In an equation: the future value of n payments of 1 at i% per period.

commands.name: USPV(i%:n)
commands.description: In an equation: the present value of n payments of 1 at i% per period.

commands.name: VOL
commands.description: Opens the volume units.

commands.name: W.MN
commands.description: In the FRCST menu: the mean of the x values weighted by the y list.

commands.name: WEEK
commands.description: Repeats the appointment every so many weeks (the number shown).

commands.name: X (PROB)
commands.description: The number of items to choose from, for CX,Y and PX,Y.

commands.name: XCOORD(r:a)
commands.description: In an equation: the x coordinate of the polar point (r, a), angle a in the mode in use.

commands.name: XCORD
commands.description: The x coordinate of a point. Store XCORD and YCORD, then R or ∡ gives the polar form; or store R and ∡ and this works x out.

commands.name: XLIST
commands.description: In the FRCST menu (its label is the x list's name): store an x value to forecast y, or forecast x from a stored y.

commands.name: XOR
commands.description: In an equation's condition: true when exactly one side is true.

commands.name: Y (PROB)
commands.description: The number of items chosen, for CX,Y and PX,Y.

commands.name: YARD
commands.description: A length in yards: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a length was stored in another unit of LENG, converts it to yards.

commands.name: YCOORD(r:a)
commands.description: In an equation: the y coordinate of the polar point (r, a), angle a in the mode in use.

commands.name: YCORD
commands.description: The y coordinate of a point: stored, or worked out from R and ∡.

commands.name: YLD%
commands.description: The yearly yield in percent, to maturity or to the call date. Stores the number shown, or works it out from PRICE.

commands.name: YLIST
commands.description: In the FRCST menu (its label is the y list's name): store a y value to forecast x, or forecast y from a stored x.

commands.name: YR#
commands.description: The year to depreciate: 1, 2 and so on.
Raises the number before it to the power of the next one: 2 ^ 3 = 8.

commands.name: x²
commands.description: The square of the number shown.

commands.name: x≷y
commands.description: Swaps the last two numbers of the history stack (in RPN the X and Y registers).

commands.name: °C
commands.description: A temperature in degrees Celsius: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a temperature was stored in another unit of TEMP, converts it to degrees Celsius.

commands.name: °F
commands.description: A temperature in degrees Fahrenheit: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a temperature was stored in another unit of TEMP, converts it to degrees Fahrenheit.

commands.name: °K
commands.description: A temperature in kelvins: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a temperature was stored in another unit of TEMP, converts it to kelvins.

commands.name: °R
commands.description: A temperature in degrees Rankine: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a temperature was stored in another unit of TEMP, converts it to degrees Rankine.
Multiplies the number before it by the next one.
Divides the number before it by the next one.

commands.name: Σ (key)
commands.description: Types the Σ character, for the summation function in an equation.

commands.name: Σ(ctr:c1:c2:s:expr)
commands.description: In an equation: the sum of expr as the counter ctr runs from c1 to c2 in steps of s.

commands.name: ΣX
commands.description: In the FRCST menu: the sum of the x list.

commands.name: ΣX2
commands.description: In the FRCST menu: the x values squared and added up.

commands.name: ΣXY
commands.description: In the FRCST menu: each x times its y, added up.

commands.name: ΣY
commands.description: In the FRCST menu: the sum of the y list.

commands.name: ΣY2
commands.description: In the FRCST menu: the y values squared and added up.
Rolls the history stack up; in a list or the Solver, moves to the previous item or equation.

commands.name: →DEG
commands.description: Turns an angle in radians into decimal degrees.

commands.name: →HMS
commands.description: Turns decimal hours (or degrees) into H.MMSS form.

commands.name: →HR
commands.description: Turns hours (or degrees) in H.MMSS form into decimal hours.

commands.name: →RAD
commands.description: Turns an angle in decimal degrees into radians.
Rolls the history stack down; in a list or the Solver, moves to the next item or equation.
Jumps the cursor to the start of the line.
Jumps the cursor past the end of the line.
Subtracts the next number from the one before it.

commands.name: √x
commands.description: The square root of the number shown.
The polar angle of a point, in the angle mode in use: stored, or worked out from XCORD and YCORD.
Moves the cursor right by one character.
Moves the cursor left by one character.
Backspace: erases the last character typed, or the whole number when no cursor shows.
